_doc: T-shirt size SCALE (ranges) used to classify a computed PERT SP value into a display T-shirt label. Distinct from tshirt-to-sp.json, which converts an EXISTING Jira T-Shirt field value into an SP number for the sp-field-priority fallback chain. Harvested from the Estimations Agent spec (pi-estimation-api/manifest.md).
